correctness.rationale: Both update branches are contractions for every positive h,p. A full stationary mean/variance calculation yields an exact signed rational comparison. Descartes gives one positive cubic root for each p, the resultant identifies the only possible global maximizing step, strict convexity of its quintic gives uniqueness, and the p-derivative geometry isolates the unique tangent probability. The packaged verifier checks the recurrence identities, resultant, denominator, rational cases, and root brackets; numerical checks are auxiliary to the analytical proof.

value.rationale: A sampler with positive inclusion probabilities is required to represent every operator component. The theorem gives a motivated complete fixed-step stationary sampling phase diagram on the smallest heterogeneous affine example: below a sharp threshold a legal best distribution exists, at equality it is algebraically identified, and above the threshold long-time risk minimization becomes nonattaining and drives probabilities toward discarding a needed component. This exposes a meaningful tuning failure not detected by unbiasedness or finite-horizon estimates. The result is explicitly narrow, not a general integrator theorem.
